# rixl_video_heatmap (Data Source)

Retrieves engagement heatmap data showing audience retention across video timestamps.

### Required

### Optional

- `buckets` (Number) The buckets query parameter.
- `rangeend` (String) The range.end query parameter.
- `rangestart` (String) The range.start query parameter.

### Read-Only
